prior_exposure: NUM1/NUM2 failures known; fixed new methods/verification policy before new tests
scope: controlled fixtures first, never final holdout
method: Independent LMS+shift scrambled Sobol nets with power-of-two draws, ordered inverse-CDF ancestor selection and fixed90/10 defensive Laplace mixture; exact target densities
scramble: SeedSequence(seed, spawn_key=(time_bin,)); Sobol bits52, no optimization, no skipping/thinning, no quantile endpoint clipping
criterion: At final131072 budget, every bin and trial maximum absolute replicate error plus1.96 replicate SD plus independent-oracle sensitivity <=0.001; all16 seeds mandatory, endpoint first registered seed, never best replica or ensemble mean
reference_policy: Highest GH order, checked against two previous GH orders and independent GL orders64/96/128, stable covariance tail sensitivity at domain12; summed sensitivities <=1e-7. Not certified quadrature absolute error.
failure: Correctness test failure prevents fixtures; unresolved oracle prevents stochastic evaluation for that fixture; accuracy judged after complete prespecified repetitions and budgets for a fixture, then STOP on any mandatory failure. No post-result changes.
uncertainty: Separate SD, mean-minus-oracle, uncertainty of mean, prefix Jensen gap, oracle order/domain differences. Finite samples do not prove unbiased log scores or absolute accuracy.
fairness: Same joint Poisson marginal likelihood as frozen models; state/initial prior sampled with explicit zero state correction, exact ancestor-specific latent prior/full mixture q. Exact HMM remains exact. No model grid, split, fitted parameter, selection or final holdout changes.
limits: Lexicographic ordering is not Hilbert SQMC, no theorem-level rate claim. Success on3-bin fixtures does not establish real trial accuracy.
on_pass: Proceed to original development M4 competition only with separate prospective real-evaluation registration using unchanged model fitting grid and candidate/reference checks; no neural claim from fixture PASS.
